findings.problem: best_overall_yield_pct 75.2 is not this patent's yield at all: it is the yield of the competing Heilongjiang University NBS route that [0006] quotes in order to criticise it, and the uuid beside it points at a one-step Background pathway.
findings.quote: 黑龙江大学的专利号CN105601548A报道了以3-氯-2-甲基苯胺为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，也是以昂贵NBS为溴化剂，会有大量固废产生，且收率偏低，只有75.2％。
findings.should_be: 69.88, pointing at a0f0bd17-4bd9-5be2-aab9-02c121628d45 (scope patent) or 3f019f3d-7b62-5de4-9e56-6f36ce71bffb (Example 1), which are the invention's own best. I dereferenced b97dc161 in pathways.json: scope 'section', section_label 'Background', steps 1, overall_yield_pct 75.2. finalise.py:301 takes max over every pathway with a non-null overall_yield_pct and applies no scope or section filter, so the two Background pathways carrying prior-art yields (67.0 from [0005], 75.2 from [0006]) compete with the real routes and one of them wins. The invention's four examples close at 69.88, 66.69, 69.23 and 67.64 percent, all of which I recomputed from the printed step yields and all of which are below 75.2. Minimal correction: restrict the max at finalise.py:301 to pathways with scope == 'patent', or exclude section_type background. A benchmark reading this field gets a flatly wrong fact about the patent, and gets it in the direction that makes the invention look better than the document claims.

findings.problem: Four of the nine key starting materials are the feedstocks of the prior-art routes the background attacks, not of this invention: 2,6-dichlorotoluene, 3-chloro-2-methylaniline, 2-chlorotoluene and sodium methoxide.
findings.quote: 拜耳公司的专利号CN1323292A报道了以2,6-二氯甲苯为起始原料合成环磺酮的工艺
findings.should_be: The invention's starting materials are methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate, 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol and 1,3-cyclohexanedione. 2,6-dichlorotoluene is CN1323292A's ([0005] line 96), 3-chloro-2-methylaniline is CN105601548A's ([0006] line 98), 2-chlorotoluene is CN104292137A's ([0007] line 100) and sodium methoxide is the 《农药》 paper's reagent, described as 原料 at [0009] line 107. All four are correctly tagged compound_class:starting_material at the compound layer, where the tag means 'named as a starting material somewhere in this document'; the defect is that finalise.py:313 promotes that tag straight to a patent-level headline field with no scope filter. Same root cause as the best_overall_yield_pct finding. Minimal correction: filter key_starting_materials to compounds that appear in a pathway of scope 'patent'.

findings.problem: The nine entries are only five distinct molecules, because two molecules are each held twice under two English spellings of one Chinese name.
findings.quote: 将40g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.6％、0.152mol)
findings.artifact_says: 'methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate' (uuid bdd5ca96) and 'methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-(methylsulfonyl)benzoate' (uuid d95a047c) are both listed; so are '1,3-cyclohexanedione' (uuid d24f0a57) and 'cyclohexane-1,3-dione' (uuid 72241169)
findings.should_be: 2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯 appears once in the document and must be one record; (methanesulfonyl) and (methylsulfonyl) are two renderings of 甲磺酰基. Likewise 1,3-环己二酮 is one molecule and 1,3-cyclohexanedione / cyclohexane-1,3-dione are two spellings of it. Both duplicates carry distinct compound_uuids, so no downstream check can see they are the same. Normalising the two pairs takes the list from nine entries to seven, and combined with the prior-art filter above takes it to three. This is the same naming-inconsistency defect A5 recorded on CN104292137A's compound_count, surfacing here in a headline list rather than a count.

findings.problem: The summary describes step 3 as an O-acylation followed by an acetone-cyanohydrin-mediated rearrangement, a two-stage mechanism that neither the prose nor the drawn scheme states.
findings.quote: 将1,3-环己二酮、溶剂加入反应瓶，在30℃以下滴加三乙胺，LC跟踪至反应完全；反应完全后，加入丙酮氰醇，LC跟踪至反应完全
findings.artifact_says: followed by O-acylation of 1,3-cyclohexanedione under triethylamine and acetone-cyanohydrin-mediated rearrangement to the 2-aroylcyclohexane-1,3-dione
findings.should_be: Say what the document says: the acid chloride is combined with 1,3-cyclohexanedione and triethylamine, then acetone cyanohydrin is added, giving tembotrione. Claim 1 step 3), [0018] and [0025] name only the charges and the order of addition; no line uses 重排 or any word for rearrangement, and no line calls the acylation O- or C-. The drawn scheme on p05 (line 152, step_id 4) draws one arrow from acid chloride plus dione straight to the C-acylated product with 三乙胺/丙酮氰醇 over it, so the page shows a single net transformation, not two. The only enol ester the document names is 3-氧代-1-环己烯酯 at [0007] line 100, and that is an intermediate of the prior-art CN104292137A route, not of this one. I note the label is not invented at A4 alone: reactions.json tags Example 1-4 Step 3 and Claims Step 3 with transformation:rearrangement, so the whole annotation reads it this way. The correction is to the summary's wording, which is where the mechanism is asserted as fact.

findings.problem: The IMAGE_EXTRACT of the invention's reaction scheme drops the base drawn as an explicit co-reactant in the second equation.
findings.artifact_says: step_id 2 has two reactants and conditions: []
findings.should_be: I opened p05.png. The second equation is drawn as [methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate] + HOCH2CF3 + 碱 -> [ether], with 碱 as a third addend to the left of the arrow, in the same position and the same size as HOCH2CF3. The extract carries neither a third reactant nor a condition for it. 碱 is 碱1, potassium carbonate per claim 6 line 69, so the compound itself survives elsewhere in the corpus and no molecule is lost; what is lost is that the drawn equation requires a base. This lands in reactions.json rather than in any patent.json field, and I report it because check 9 asked me to open the pages. Minimal correction: add 碱 to step_id 2 of the line-152 extract as a reactant, matching how 氯化亚砜 is carried as a reactant in step_id 5.

findings.problem: patent_type is null although the front page prints the document kind in INID field (12).
findings.should_be: 'invention_patent_application' or equivalent. I read this off p01.png: the header line reads (12)发明专利申请 in large type, and (10)申请公布号 CN 109678767 A gives the kind code A directly. The biblio file has no patent_type key and finalise.py:384 hardcodes None, so the value was never in reach of the merge. This is the same unfixed defect A5 recorded on CN104292137A.

findings.problem: The assignee tag value carries commas and full stops, so it is not the lowercase snake_case ASCII value the tag convention requires.
findings.quote: (71) 申请人 浙江中山化工集团股份有限公司
findings.should_be: assignee:zhejiang_zhongshan_chemical_industry_group_co_ltd. finalise.py:358 slugs the assignee with a['name'].lower().replace(' ', '_'), which replaces spaces only, so every punctuation mark in the English name survives into the tag. CN104292137A did not surface this because 'Wuhan Institute of Technology' has no punctuation. Minimal correction: strip non [a-z0-9_] characters in the slug.

findings.problem: A4 rule 4 names six metadata-derived tag categories that finalise.py unions in from the biblio, but only four of them are emitted.
findings.quote: N/A - A4-patent.md rule 4: 'jurisdiction, patent_family, assignee, time_period, patent_type and legal_status are metadata-derived and finalise.py unions them in from the biblio file'; finalise.py:355-359 adds jurisdiction, patent_family, time_period, assignee and assignee_type only.
findings.artifact_says: tags contains jurisdiction:cn, patent_family:66190615, time_period:2019, assignee:..., assignee_type:company - no patent_type: tag and no legal_status: tag
findings.should_be: Add a legal_status tag, since bibliographic.legal_status is populated, and a patent_type tag once patent_type is populated. assignee_type is emitted although rule 4 does not list it, which is harmless but undocumented. Identical to the CN104292137A finding, still unfixed.

findings.problem: The full-inheritance union puts mutually contradictory values of the same single-valued category on one record, so no consumer can read a category as a value.
findings.quote: N/A - finalise.py:361 '# full inheritance: union every reaction / compound / pathway tag'
findings.artifact_says: 120 tags including both is_one_pot:false and is_one_pot:true; chain_length:1, :2, :3 and :5 together; scale:not_specified with scale:lab; purification:recrystallisation with purification:none; catalyst_class:base with catalyst_class:none
findings.should_be: This is finalise.py behaving as written, not an A4 error, so there is no correction to the LLM output. If PatentRecord.tags is meant to be queryable, single-valued categories inherited from children should be dropped or namespaced rather than unioned raw. Concretely harmful example: named_rxn:wohl_ziegler_bromination sits on the patent record, where it reads as a claim about the invention, while the Wohl-Ziegler reactions in reactions.json are the NBS brominations of the prior-art routes at [0005] and [0006]. I verified the union is otherwise exact: every one of the 120 tags is either one of the 11 LLM tags, one of the 5 metadata tags, or a tag present on a compound, reaction or pathway record, with no stray and no child tag dropped.

findings.problem: The summary calls the step 1) catalyst a 'radical catalyst', a mechanistic label the patent does not use and which does not fit one of the two catalysts claim 3 names.
findings.quote: 3.根据权利要求1或2所述的除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，其特征在于，步骤1)中，所述催化剂为偶氮二异丁腈或间氯过氧苯甲酸；双氧水的滴加温度为45～80℃。
findings.artifact_says: the identities of the step 1) radical catalyst
findings.should_be: 'the step 1) catalyst'. Claim 3 and [0020] say only 催化剂, and offer azobisisobutyronitrile or m-chloroperoxybenzoic acid as alternatives. AIBN is a radical initiator; mCPBA is a peracid and calling it a radical catalyst is the annotator's inference, not the document's word. Weaker than the rearrangement finding because the word 'radical' does no work in the sentence and removing it costs nothing.

findings.problem: A yield is bound to the wrong step: 69% is the yield [0007] gives for the prior-art tembotrione step, not for its bromination with elemental bromine.
findings.quote: 在制备2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的时候，以危险性较大的溴素为溴化剂，收率偏低，只有70％；……在制备环磺酮的时候，使用氰基丙酮价格过于昂贵，生产成本高，而且中间态……单独分离处理，导致工艺繁琐，收率偏低，只有69％。
findings.artifact_says: CN104292137A uses "the comparatively hazardous elemental bromine" at 69 to 70%
findings.should_be: 70%, which is the bromination yield. [0007] gives two separate yields for two separate defects: 70% for the bromine bromination and 69% for the tembotrione step, whose stated defects are the price of cyanoacetone and the separate isolation of the enol ester. A charitable reading of '69 to 70%' is 'the range of yields that route reports', which is true, and that is why I hedge; but as written the range attaches to the bromine clause.

findings.problem: blob_root points at a directory that does not exist anywhere in the repository, so a consumer cannot resolve any of the uuids the record hands out.
findings.should_be: 'runs/CN109678767A/output', which is where compounds.json, reactions.json and pathways.json actually live. I checked: there is no manual_annotations directory in the repository. The literal predates the multi-patent layout and was not updated with it. Every compound_uuid in extraction_rollup is a live pointer into files under runs/CN109678767A/output, and blob_root is the field that is supposed to say so.

findings.problem: The record declares language 'zh' and stores the abstract as verbatim Chinese, but stores the title only in English translation, with nothing marking the difference.
findings.quote: 一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺
findings.artifact_says: "title": "Synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione", "abstract": "本发明公开一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，...", "language": "zh"
findings.should_be: Carry the printed Chinese title alongside the English one, as the biblio file already does under title_zh, or name the title field's language. A consumer that reads language: 'zh' and then reads title and abstract gets one field in the source language and one in translation, and the record does not say which is which. Minimal correction is a title_zh slot on PatentRecord; if the schema has no such slot then this is a schema gap rather than a filling error.

findings.problem: 'Pending' for a Chinese application filed 2018-12-27 and still unexamined 7 years 8 months later is implausible on its face and I could not verify it offline.
findings.artifact_says: "legal_status": "Pending (Google Patents, retrieved 2026-08-28). Never granted: no B publication exists in this family."
findings.should_be: Verify before shipping. Under Chinese practice a request for substantive examination must be filed within three years of the filing date, which for this application expired 2021-12-27; absent that request the application is deemed withdrawn. Google Patents shows 'Pending' as its default when it holds no status event for a document, so the string may be recording an absence rather than a status. The second sentence is a separate assertion: 'no B publication exists in this family' is a negative claim about family 66190615 that nothing in the document supports. What would settle it: the CNIPA public register entry for 201811613707.4, or the Events tab of the Google Patents page the biblio cites. This is the one bibliographic field that is neither printed on the front page nor derivable from the document, and it is hand-authored.

findings.problem: The acetonitrile argument pairs [0033], which is about step 3, with claim 7, which governs step 2, so the two halves of the sentence are about different steps.
findings.quote: [0033] 3.在环磺酮的合成的时候使用DMF代替乙腈，低毒代替高毒化学品，降低生产过程中中毒事故发生。
findings.artifact_says: [0033] states that "DMF is used in place of acetonitrile", but claim 7 still lists "acetonitrile, DMF, acetone or tetrahydrofuran" as the step 2) solvent options
findings.should_be: [0033] scopes its acetonitrile replacement to 环磺酮的合成, the step 3) tembotrione synthesis, matching [0009] where the prior art used acetonitrile in that same step. Claim 7 is the step 2) solvent claim. The sentence's conclusion, that nothing in the claim set excludes acetonitrile, is nonetheless correct, and the clause that actually earns it is the next one: claim 10 recites DMF only as the step 3) catalyst and no claim defines the step 3) reaction solvent. Weak finding: the facts are individually right and the conclusion holds; only the [0033] to claim 7 juxtaposition is loose.

checks_passed.check: translation - title_en names the right molecule
checks_passed.what_was_verified: The recorded title is right and the note's reasoning holds, with stronger evidence available than the note cites. Three independent confirmations that 环磺酮 is tembotrione and not sulcotrione or mesotrione. First, the document names it in English itself: [0002] at line 90 prints 除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione) with the English in parentheses, so no translation judgement is needed at all. Second, the same line gives the chemical name 2-{2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3-[(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基]苯甲酰基}环己烷-1,3-二酮 and attributes it to Bayer in 2007, which is tembotrione exactly; sulcotrione has no trifluoroethoxymethyl group. Third, I read the product structure off p05.png myself: the drawn tembotrione carries the aroyl at C1, Cl at C2, CH2OCH2CF3 at C3 and SO2CH3 at C4 of the ring, with the 2-position of a cyclohexane-1,3-dione as the acyl acceptor, matching the [0002] name substituent for substituent and position for position. The note's separate point also checks out: [0003] at line 92 lists 硝磺草酮, 磺草酮 and 双环磺草酮 as distinct compounds from 环磺酮, so this document's Chinese distinguishes the four triketones that machine translation conflates. I found no defect in title or in title_en_note. The only thing the note leaves on the table is that it argues from the ISO common name and the route when the document prints '(Tembotrione)' outright.

checks_passed.check: fidelity - every bibliographic field read off the printed front page

(22) 申请日 2018.12.27 = filing_date 2018-12-27, correct. priority_date 2018-12-27 equals the filing date and the front page prints no (30), (31), (32) or (33) priority field anywhere, so for a CN domestic first filing this is correct rather than a copy. grant_date null is a fact: this is a (12) 发明专利申请, an application publication, and the page carries no (45) grant date and no (73) proprietor. (51) Int.Cl. prints exactly four codes, C07C 317/46(2006.01), C07C 317/44(2006.01), C07C 317/24(2006.01) and C07C 315/04(2006.01), and ipc_codes carries all four in the printed order, which is an improvement on CN104292137A where the field was null. cpc_codes null is correct; CN A publications print no CPC and this page prints none. (71) 申请人 浙江中山化工集团股份有限公司 renders as 'Zhejiang Zhongshan Chemical Industry Group Co., Ltd.', country CN, type company, which is right (股份有限公司 is strictly a joint-stock limited company, and 'Co., Ltd.' is the conventional rendering). (72) 发明人 gives six names, 刘志刚 李劲 朱梦鑫 杨志 吴同文 吴玉江, and parties.inventors carries all six in the printed order as Liu Zhigang, Li Jin, Zhu Mengxin, Yang Zhi, Wu Tongwen and Wu Yujiang, each country CN, with none dropped and none invented. examiners null is correct; an application publication names no examiner and the page carries none. jurisdiction 'cn' and language 'zh' match (10)申请公布号 CN 109678767 A. checks_passed.check: recall - abstract is the printed (57) 摘要, character for character

checks_passed.check: arithmetic - extraction_rollup recomputed from the three artifacts
checks_passed.what_was_verified: I recomputed every count independently. reaction_count 36 = len(reactions.json) exactly. compound_count 66 = len(compounds.json) exactly, and all 66 identifiers and all 66 compound_uuids are distinct. pathway_count 14 = len(pathways.json) exactly. section_summary {background: 10, claims: 3, comparative_example: 3, experimental_example: 12, summary_of_invention: 8} recomputed as a Counter over reactions.json section_type and matches exactly; the five values sum to 36 = reaction_count. scale_distribution {not_specified: 21, lab: 15} recomputed the same way and matches exactly; 21+15 = 36. checks_passed.check: precision - A4 rule 1, patent_summary shape and chemistry
checks_passed.what_was_verified: Two sentences, inside rule 1's 1 to 2. No yield, no mass and no temperature anywhere in it: the only numerals are the step count 'three-step', the claim range 'claims 2 to 10', and locants inside chemical names. The word 'batch' is not in the document, but a charge into a 500 ml four-neck flask followed by workup is batch by definition and I do not treat it as an unsupported claim.
